import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

COLL_NAME = 'Lacerda_Upper_Blockout'

# Remove only our previous bridge test object. Preserve the user's existing scene.
test = bpy.data.objects.get('Bridge_Test_Cube')
if test:
    bpy.data.objects.remove(test, do_unlink=True)

# Rebuild only this blockout collection so the command is idempotent.
old = bpy.data.collections.get(COLL_NAME)
if old:
    for obj in list(old.objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.collections.remove(old)

coll = bpy.data.collections.new(COLL_NAME)
bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

# Helpers
def mat(name, rgba, metallic=0.0, rough=0.55):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = rgba
    m.metallic = metallic
    m.roughness = rough
    return m

ivory = mat('Lacerda_Ivory', (0.78, 0.73, 0.61, 1.0), 0.0, 0.72)
dark = mat('Lacerda_WindowDark', (0.07, 0.09, 0.10, 1.0), 0.05, 0.25)
stone = mat('Lacerda_PlazaStone', (0.30, 0.30, 0.28, 1.0), 0.0, 0.88)
metal = mat('Lacerda_Metal', (0.18, 0.18, 0.16, 1.0), 0.45, 0.35)

def cube(name, loc, dims, material=None, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    # Move from default collection into our isolated collection.
    for c in list(o.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(o)
    coll.objects.link(o)
    if material:
        o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel > 0:
        mod = o.modifiers.new('Soft_Edges', 'BEVEL')
        mod.width = bevel
        mod.segments = 2
    return o

# Coordinate convention: facade/front = -Y, Z up, metres.
# Plaza / upper-city datum.
cube('Plaza_Upper', (0, 0, -0.18), (48.0, 34.0, 0.36), stone, 0.06)

# Ground station volume and projecting access canopy.
cube('Station_Ground', (0, 0.3, 2.1), (22.0, 11.5, 4.2), ivory, 0.10)
cube('Entrance_Canopy', (0, -6.6, 4.05), (24.5, 3.2, 0.38), ivory, 0.08)

# Main upper-station Art Deco mass.
cube('Station_Main', (0, 1.2, 11.2), (18.2, 9.2, 14.0), ivory, 0.12)

# Slight stepped crown visible above the LACERDA signage.
cube('Crown_Base', (0, 0.9, 18.65), (13.4, 7.2, 0.9), ivory, 0.10)
cube('Crown_Center', (0, 0.75, 19.45), (7.0, 6.4, 0.8), ivory, 0.10)

# Strong vertical facade pilasters characteristic of the upper entrance.
for i, x in enumerate((-8.0, -5.35, -2.68, 0.0, 2.68, 5.35, 8.0)):
    cube(f'Facade_Pilaster_{i+1:02d}', (x, -3.52, 12.15), (0.52, 0.58, 11.9), ivory, 0.035)

# Window bays: dark recessed panels, separated by pale spandrels.
xs = (-6.68, -4.02, -1.34, 1.34, 4.02, 6.68)
zs = (7.15, 10.25, 13.35, 16.45)
for r, z in enumerate(zs):
    for c, x in enumerate(xs):
        cube(f'Window_Front_{r+1:02d}_{c+1:02d}', (x, -3.84, z), (1.62, 0.12, 2.05), dark, 0.02)

# Ground-floor entrance openings beneath canopy.
for i, x in enumerate((-7.5, -4.5, -1.5, 1.5, 4.5, 7.5)):
    cube(f'Ground_Opening_{i+1:02d}', (x, -5.49, 1.85), (2.05, 0.14, 2.75), dark, 0.025)

# Simple railing/parapet along the cliff-side edge to establish game-space scale.
cube('Cliff_Parapet_Left', (-17.5, 10.2, 0.65), (13.0, 0.38, 1.3), ivory, 0.05)
cube('Cliff_Parapet_Right', (17.5, 10.2, 0.65), (13.0, 0.38, 1.3), ivory, 0.05)

# Sign text, intentionally separate so it can be replaced by final geometry later.
bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=(0, -3.93, 18.25), rotation=(1.57079632679, 0, 0))
t = bpy.context.object
t.name = 'Sign_LACERDA_Blockout'
t.data.body = 'LACERDA'
t.data.align_x = 'CENTER'
t.data.align_y = 'CENTER'
t.data.size = 1.05
t.data.extrude = 0.05
t.data.bevel_depth = 0.015
for c in list(t.users_collection):
    c.objects.unlink(t)
coll.objects.link(t)
t.data.materials.append(metal)

# Reference empty at the main entrance/player datum.
bpy.ops.object.empty_add(type='PLAIN_AXES', location=(0, -9.0, 0.0))
ref = bpy.context.object
ref.name = 'REF_Player_Entrance'
ref.empty_display_size = 1.8
for c in list(ref.users_collection):
    c.objects.unlink(ref)
coll.objects.link(ref)

# Select blockout and frame it in a visible 3D viewport when possible.
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in coll.objects:
    o.select_set(True)
if coll.objects:
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = coll.objects[0]
try:
    for area in bpy.context.screen.areas:
        if area.type == 'VIEW_3D':
            region = next((r for r in area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'), None)
            if region:
                with bpy.context.temp_override(window=bpy.context.window, screen=bpy.context.screen, area=area, region=region):
                    bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
                break
except Exception:
    pass

print(f'Built {COLL_NAME} with {len(coll.objects)} objects; preserved all non-bridge scene content.')
